title: From idea to release
description: An illustrative workflow for a small project team.

data.label: Shape the idea
data.description: Agree on the problem and what a good outcome looks like.

data.label: Make a small change
data.description: Keep the source clear, focused and easy to review.

data.label: Review together
data.description: Check the behavior and inspect the actual result.

data.label: Share the result
data.description: Publish only the work that is ready to be shared.
